snippet.title: Stackmancy Demo Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist on Steam - https://store.steampowered.com/app/3612610/Stackmancy/

Stackmancy is a fast-paced roguelite card game where you pop spell packs, stack powerful combos, and eliminate enemies on your journey to become the Grand Stackmancer.
